WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.member_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.sale_ts_utc, f.etl_loaded_at,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id) nret
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 30

SELECT min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), count(*), sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_p2,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22') p2_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s USING(sales_line_id) WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22') p2_returns,
 (SELECT min(return_date)||' '||max(return_date) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s USING(sales_line_id) WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22') ret_range

calls.statement:
SELECT s.format, s.store_id=900 AS web, COALESCE(w.status,'(store)') status, f.channel_code,
  count(*) n, round(sum(f.net_amount),2) sold, round(sum(r.refund_net),2) refunded, count(r.sales_line_id) nret,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ztest
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND s.store_id=900
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, l.format,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS sold_net,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0), 2) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY l.format
ORDER BY CASE l.format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Small' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
